comment: "I found the focus on early recognition of LAST signs particularly valuable. Understanding subtle clinical indicators and how to differentiate them from other complications was extremely insightful."
"The course content was presented in an easy to understand format. I also like that there were extra reading material and resources provided."
"I liked the format of each slide being a question and the content of the slide being an answer."

"I liked the section describing the safe limits and calculations for dosages of local anaesthetic drugs, as well as the section describing bolus and infusion dosages on Intralipid were both insightful and useful to guide future practice."
"I liked the evaluation at the end - really tested my understanding."
"I was lucky to take this course."
"I just wish to say thank you. I am happy to have taken this course. Thank you for the opportunity."
"In this course I found it most interesting learning about the side effects of LAST and what it does after being injected."
